sentences.text: First application of the applicants was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to renew the prayer after filing of charge sheet by this Court vide order dated 19.03.2024 in M.Cr.C.No.11529 of 2024.
Learned counsel for the applicants argued that the applicants are innocent and have been falsely implicated.
Forensic Lab report dated 09.05.2024 is not corroborative in respect to alleged video made by the applicants/accused persons.
Further submission is that allegation of sexual assault has not been levelled against the applicants/accused persons.
There is a delay in filing F.I.R..
The applicants/accused are under custody since 21.02.2024.

Since charge sheet has been filed,
therefore, custodial interrogation of the applicants/accused is not required anymore.

Further submission is that the applicants/accused are the permanent resident of Mungawali, District Ashoknagar (M.P.) and there is no possibility of their absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Hence, prayed for grant of bail to the applicants.
O n the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer for respondent No.1/State vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for rejection of present bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that applicants be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) each with two solvent sureties of Rs.50,000/- each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE AK/-
